g.title: crate Arvane: the public facade of the Arvane layer.
crate::asset Explicit image and font services exposed by the Arvane facade.
crate::embed Embedded window creation with the shared rendering driver.
crate::engine Engine: text shaping, measuring and fonts for its creating UI thread.
crate::env Environment variable configuration for Arvane.
crate::error Classify external text and rendering failures using shared failure values.
crate::presentation Defines renderer choices and presentation change notifications.
crate::presenter RenderScene presentation and frame policy.
crate::presenter::frame A frame's raster plan, and what presenting it did.
crate::presenter::frame_policy Presenter: one window's renderers and the policy applied to each frame.
crate::presenter::gpu A presenter's GPU renderer and its life cycle (feature `gpu`).
crate::presenter::health What a window's surface did with the frames that reached it.
crate::presenter::test_frames Presents test-window frames and keeps them as pixels (feature `testing`).
crate::rasterizer CPU image output independent of windows, using the window rasterizer.
crate::shutdown Record detached workers and retain embedded code after owned fields drop.
crate::test_display::environment What this test process offers: display counters and GPU availability.
crate::test_display::font The bundled Tuffy test font, drawn the same on every machine.
crate::test_display::shell In-memory shell services with an optional native display mirror.
crate::test_display::virtual_window VirtualWindow: an in-memory test window and the controls tests drive.
crate::window Native window abstraction and lifecycle.
